title: The pointer-head guard lets an agent detach in its own worktree
why: The pointer-head hook refused `git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD` in an agent's own worktree on PR #1625, though briefs tell agents to detach (coordinator, 17:17 CST Nov 7). A false alarm on an act the briefs require.
note: Done check: a red test on the detach in an agent-owned tree, with a detach in the main checkout still refused. Unclear: guard_pointer.py passes other trees; no detach test or Nov 7 fix found (triage reader agent, Explore Sonnet audit, read of origin/main 0e6509a96,  CST Nov 10).
